children: On September 14, 2026, the company received a notice from Nasdaq that it is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5450(a)(2) requiring at least 400 total holders for the Nasdaq Global Market. The notice has no immediate effect; the company has until October 29, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with a potential extension of up to 180 days if accepted, and may consider transferring to the Nasdaq Capital Market.
